subject: Mutual Action Plan + proposed discount / commit — Veridian Systems
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@veridian.com>, Mike Glover <mike.glover@veridian.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan + proposed discount / commit — Veridian Systems

Hi Sarah and Mike —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures the evaluation milestones and the proposed close timeline to hit your Q4 production target. Key commercial point we discussed: Veridian is asking for an introductory discount to accelerate the pilot -> commit path.

Summary of proposal (high level):
- 12-month commit if production SLA met within 60 days after pilot signoff
- Upfront volume commit: 25k monthly tokens (starting month 1) with staged ramp to 100k by month 6
- Introductory credit: one-time 40% discount applied to first 60 days of billed usage (pilot + ramp month 1)
- Standard renewal pricing thereafter, with performance-based rebate tied to usage SLAs

I flagged the commercial ask internally (cc'd Marissa/Ben/Karthik) because this sits above our standard 25% discount guardrail and will need finance sign-off for anything above 30%. Sarah/Mike — if you can confirm the ramp plan and target go-live date (we've penciled in 2026-11-15), I'll push the MAP+term sheet forward for internal approval.

Attachments: veridian_map_v2.pdf (MAP draft), commercial_term_sheet_v2.xlsx (term sheet)

Next steps:
1) Veridian confirms timelines and acceptance of MAP (reply)
2) Redwood crew routes discount approval internally and returns a signable term sheet
3) If approved, I will send DocuSign and schedule kickoff

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0189

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + proposed discount / commit — Veridian Systems

Alex — thanks for the context and the MAP. I skimmed the term sheet; 40% one-time is outside our standard delegated authority. Internal ask: please get me the ARR profile and estimated margin impact for the first 12 months (spread with the ramp). Ben — can you run a quick scenario (sheet attached would help).

Questions for the group:
- Is the 40% being requested as a prepaid credit or an invoice-level discount?
- Do we have precedent for a contingent rebate tied to usage meters vs. flat intro discounts for this seat/usage profile?

I want to route this to Lauren (CFO) for sign-off but prefer we have a succinct one-page impact memo we can share with her + Markus if it crosses >40% discount. Alex, please include why this deal should be prioritized for a deeper discount (strategic logo, reference, marketplace listing).

Marissa
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + proposed discount / commit — Veridian Systems

Looping in Lauren for visibility. Quick notes from Sales Ops / Commercial:
- If the intro discount is an invoice-level line item we can do a one-time credit; if it's a lasting net price change that's effectively a contract amendment and requires longer approvals.
- Approval thresholds (current): up to 25% senior AE/AM; 25-35% requires VP; 35-50% requires CFO; >50% requires CEO sign-off.
- Estimated first-year revenue (baseline, no discount): ~$1.1M ARR (annualized run-rate given the ramp). With a one-time 40% credit on the first two months we estimate a ~6-7% net revenue hit in year 1; if we convert earlier than expected the lifetime value still looks attractive but we need to model cashflow.

I attached a quick "discount impact" snapshot (discount_impact_summary.png) and updated the term sheet with a conditional line for a one-time 40% credit applied to months 0-1 if they sign the 12-month commit within 14 days.

Action items:
- Alex: confirm whether Veridian expects the discount as a credit or a permanent price change (reply to thread)
- Alex: send any customer references / strategic rationale for priority handling
- Lauren: will you please indicate whether CFO sign-off is required for this one-time construct?

Ben
Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@veridian.com>, Mike Glover <mike.glover@veridian.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + proposed discount / commit — Veridian Systems

Hi Sarah / Mike — quick answers to Ben/Marissa's questions and an updated MAP attached:
- The ask from Veridian is for a one-time invoice credit applied to the first 60 days of billed usage (not a permanent price change).
- Rationale: Veridian has agreed to be a launch partner for our Marketplace listing and will provide an internal case study and two public quotes after month 3. They also signaled willingness to participate in a joint webinar (marketing) if we can commit to a fast pilot timeline.

Updated timeline:
- Pilot start: 2026-10-20
- Pilot validation (success criteria): 2026-11-20
- Production go-live: 2026-11-15 (dependent on pilot completion; final date will be the later of the two)

I've attached the redlined MAP and a short one-pager that summarizes the strategic value. If finance can sign off on a one-time 40% credit for the first 60 days, we will proceed with DocuSign immediately.

Attachments: veridian_map_v2.pdf, commercial_term_sheet_v2.xlsx

Thanks —
Alex

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 7 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + proposed discount / commit — Veridian Systems

Team — reviewed Ben's impact snapshot and Alex's strategic notes. Given this is a one-time invoice credit (not a contract-level price concession) and Veridian's value as a marketplace launch and public reference, I approve a staged credit structure as follows:

1) Approve a one-time 40% credit applied to billed usage for the first 60 days post-signature, provided Veridian executes a 12-month MSA with the specified volume commit and the MAP milestones are met.
2) Require a clawback clause: if Veridian fails to meet the agreed pilot success criteria by 2026-11-20 without documented vendor-side blockers, the credit will be reversed and invoiced.
3) Commercial to finalize DocuSign with the conditional credit line and the clawback language.

Markus — flagging in case you'd like a quick read; otherwise I'll instruct Legal/Commercial to send the DocuSign and loop in finance for booking treatment.

Lauren Bishop
CFO, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0112
